ev.q: Gameplay consists of a combination of puzzle solving and combat
Characters within the party gain experience for slaying creatures
Players control a party of one to four characters
a disembodied voice which comes to them in their sleep
left remembering routes and paths through the dungeon completely down to the player
Many of the harder puzzles throughout the game are designed as bonuses
finds notes from a previous wanderer of the dungeon named Toorum
Some reviewers commented negatively on the game's combat system
